# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test

    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1610
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1610
- **Title**: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1602` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1543
- **Deletions**: -110
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T12:39:46Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T16:11:22Z

## PR Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1610
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1610
- **Title**: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1602` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1543
- **Deletions**: -110
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T12:39:46Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T16:11:22Z

## PR Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

Hmm — "so all three surfaces agree" — the faces show `attempt ${attempt+1}/$maxAttempts` = 2/4 while the record says attempt=1, max=4. Is that "agreeing"? # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1610
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1610
- **Title**: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1602` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1543
- **Deletions**: -110
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T12:39:46Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T16:11:22Z

## PR Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.
Now let me look at the current repo state — git log, branch, diff vs base, and check whether the fixes described in the previous rework's replies ("Thread 1-6") are present in the working tree.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1610
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1610
- **Title**: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1602` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 8
- **Additions**: +1543
- **Deletions**: -110
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T12:39:46Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-14T16:11:22Z

## PR Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

```

Mixed-chain trace (maxAttempts=3, maxRateLimitRetries=3): 429 → retry → transport failure → retry → 429 → retry → transport failure → `attemptLog.length` is already 4 ≥ 3, so the transport ladder is exhausted after only **2** real transport attempts, with a "Provider call failed after 4 attempt(s)" terminal.

Impact is bounded (the `maxAttempts + maxRateLimitRetries` alternation net caps total attempts, and the terminal embeds the raw 429 lines so the roles layer still classifies it), so this is polish, not a bug — but the doc claim is only half-true. # pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate

The rate-limit path passes the *upcoming* attempt number, so the display double-increments.

Empirically confirmed on this branch (3 consecutive 429s, scripted sleeper/noticer):

```
DISPLAYS: [retrying in 2s (attempt 3/4), retrying in 4s (attempt 4/4), retrying in 9s (attempt 5/4)]

if (state.attemptLog.length >= maxAttempts) {
```

Mixed-chain trace (maxAttempts=3, maxRateLimitRetries=3): 429 → retry → transport failure → retry → 429 → retry → transport failure → `attemptLog.length` is already 4 ≥ 3, so the transport ladder is exhausted after only **2** real transport attempts, with a "Provider call failed after 4 attempt(s)" terminal.

Impact is bounded (the `maxAttempts + maxRateLimitRetries` alternation net caps total attempts, and the terminal embeds the raw 429 lines so the roles layer still classifies it), so this is polish, not a bug — but the doc claim is only half-true. # pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

`_afterRateLimitFailure` passes `state.rateLimitRetries + 1` as the `attempt` argument of `_pauseBetweenAttempts`:

```dart
return _pauseBetweenAttempts(
  out,
  model,
  failure.error,

But the `TransientRetryNotice` contract documents `attempt` as **"the 1-based attempt that just failed"**, and `_wireTransientRetryNotice` (agent_cli_io.dart) renders `attempt + 1` — the transport path passes `state.attemptLog.length` (failed attempts), which is why it displays correctly. The rate-limit path passes the *upcoming* attempt number, so the display double-increments.

Empirically confirmed on this branch (3 consecutive 429s, scripted sleeper/noticer):

```
DISPLAYS: [retrying in 2s (attempt 3/4), retrying in 4s (attempt 4/4), retrying in 9s (attempt 5/4)]
RECORDS:  [{attempt: 2, max_attempts: 4}, {attempt: 3, ...}, {attempt: 4, ...}]
```

Consequences:

- The first retry prints `attempt 3/4` (it is attempt 2 of 4); the third prints `attempt 5/4` — beyond the declared 4-attempt budget.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-14):

💡 **SUGGESTION: rate-limit retries erode the transport budget via the shared `attemptLog`**

The invariant stated at `maxRateLimitRetries` and `_DriveState.rateLimitRetries` is "the two classes alternate, so the classes must not eat each other's budget" — but only the rate-limit class has a private counter. The transport bound here checks the **shared** log:

```dart
if (state.attemptLog.length >= maxAttempts) {
```

Mixed-chain trace (maxAttempts=3, maxRateLimitRetries=3): 429 → retry → transport failure → retry → 429 → retry → transport failure → `attemptLog.length` is already 4 ≥ 3, so the transport ladder is exhausted after only **2** real transport attempts, with a "Provider call failed after 4 attempt(s)" terminal.

Impact is bounded (the `maxAttempts + maxRateLimitRetries` alternation net caps total attempts, and the terminal embeds the raw 429 lines so the roles layer still classifies it), so this is polish, not a bug — but the doc claim is only half-true. Consider counting transport-class entries only (a `transportAttempts` counter beside `rateLimitRetries`), or soften the "must not eat each other's budget" comment to describe the actual asymmetric budget.

# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.

# pr-1610: gh-1602 Retry provider 429/5xx with backoff instead of failing the trial: one rate-limit error killed 5 of 30 trials in run 7 (n_retries=0)

## Description

Closes #1602
### Root Cause

In fa's provider layer the transient retry ladder deliberately excluded rate limits ("they stay with the roles layer") — but the roles layer is only wired when a model-roles chain is configured. The harbor bench runs a single provider/model, so a `429: Rate limit reached` traveled un-retried, ended the run with exit 1, and harbor recorded `ApiRateLimitError` — reward 0 for a mid-progress trial (run 7: 5 of 30 trials, `n_retries: 0`, one killed after a single request).

### Fix

- `lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart`: new pre-commit rate-limit class — `isRateLimitError` + `matchesRateLimitWording`; up to `maxRateLimitRetries` (3) in-place replays with capped exponential backoff (`rateLimitBackoffFor`: 2s floor, 60s cap, ≤25% upward jitter), honoring the provider's `Retry-After` verbatim; budget separate from the transport ladder.
- Deadline bound (AC2): `transientRetryDeadlineLeft` (global seam wired from `AgentCli`'s `SessionDeadline`) — a retry sleep that would cross `deadline − transientRetryWrapUpMargin` (default 120s, the harbor `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS = cap − 120s` contract) is never started; the ladder fails with a truthful deadline terminal instead.
- Exhaustion/deadline terminals embed the raw per-attempt 429 lines, so when a roles chain or provider queue IS configured, `isRateLimitOrQuota`/`classifyQueueDeath` still rotate and fail over as before; 401/403/400 and `insufficient_quota` (budget exhaustion, issue #926) stay fatal; mid-answer 429s still stand (no replay over streamed deltas).
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_io.dart` + `agent_cli.dart`: the announced retry renders as `[net] rate limited …` (transport keeps `[net] connection lost`) and appends the hidden `429_retry` record (`attempt`, `max_attempts`, `delay_ms`, `reason`, `ts`) to the session JSONL — the post-mortem surface for bench shards.
- `bench/harbor_fa/fa_agent.py` deliberately unchanged: the ticket marks the `fa --resume` relaunch "optionally", and with the blip absorbed in-process the failure mode it guards no longer exists.

### Test Coverage

- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_repro_test.dart` — the RED proof (pre-fix: 429 killed the call, 1 request, no retry).
- `test/providers/gh1602_rate_limit_retry_test.dart` — 14 tests: 429-then-200 retried and completes (AC1); `Retry-After` honored verbatim (AC2); 2s→4s→8s backoff with cap; budget exhaustion into a terminal `isRateLimitOrQuota` still classifies (roles rotation intact); no retry past the wrap-up margin, Retry-After vs allowance both directions; 401 and `insufficient_quota` fatal; mid-answer 429 stands.
- `test/cli/gh1602_rate_limit_headless_test.dart` — headless `fa -p` with a scripted 429-then-200: exit 0, `[net] rate limited` notice, `429_retry` record in the session JSONL (AC1).
- Full suite: `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the CI per-PR gate) — **10719 passed, 10 skipped (environment-gated), 0 failures**; the three gh-1602 files re-run green on the final tree (17 passed).

### Notes

- AC3 (re-run of the run7 shard) needs a live bench run; this fix removes the in-process cause — a blip now heals within the trial. A genuinely dead quota still ends the trial, with the terminal quoting the raw 429 evidence (harbor's anchored classifier reads it correctly).
- Roles-configured users see key rotation happen AFTER the provider ladder's own backoff budget (omp's retry-then-rotate order) instead of immediately; single-key chains are unaffected in behavior.
- The flutter app host gets the attempt-budget bound only (null deadline seam default); wiring its clock is a one-line host change if it ever arms one.
- Pre-existing, unrelated: `dart test test/cli/` aborts at process exit in `tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` teardown (`malloc_consolidate` corruption) — reproduced on clean base 92e9392, all 5 of its tests pass before the abort.
Now let me look at the current repo state — git log, branch, diff vs base, and check whether the fixes described in the previous rework's replies ("Thread 1-6") are present in the working tree.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

return _pauseBetweenAttempts(

);

- **Transport budget erosion**: a dedicated `transportAttempts` counter now sits beside `rateLimitRetries` in `_DriveState`; the transport bound and transport notice read `state.transportAttempts` (mid-answer resume attempts count into it too), never the shared `attemptLog`. tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only

    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need

    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
